official_submission_formats.AVS: internal evaluation set: ranked segment/frame list with relevance grades

notes: KIS/VQA intervals accept any frame in the specified event interval.
TRAKE uses one precise semantic keyframe per ordered event; each GT window is 9 frames.

All queries were designed from direct inspection of L21_V001 visual content and readable on-screen text.
